subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader PR be the canonical landing for the Tavily SecretRef issue, including the generic agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot repair, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110 land and the agent repair be split out?
rationale: Both branches are credible and proof-positive, but selecting the permanent scope and canonical branch is an ownership decision that code review alone cannot safely resolve.

options.title: Land the broader guarded fix
options.body: Refresh and land this PR so one branch fixes both the Tavily fallback and agent Tool Search snapshot ordering, then retire overlapping Tavily-only candidates.

options.title: Split the agent repair
options.body: Land the narrower Tavily-only PR and require the generic runtime-snapshot helper and tests in a separate focused PR.

options.title: Pause the broader scope
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it only if maintainers intentionally reject the adjacent agent Tool Search repair from this landing path.

recommendation.title: Land the broader guarded fix
recommendation.body: Refresh and land this PR so one branch fixes both the Tavily fallback and agent Tool Search snapshot ordering, then retire overlapping Tavily-only candidates.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned and directly integrated the current branch head, providing the strongest evidence of responsibility for the canonical landing choice.
